title: Gangtise投研 MCP
description: Gangtise MCP汇聚机构级观点，研报，日程等另类数据，提供投研AI Agent预生成数据及全球行情/财务/估值/宏观行业等结构化数据。Key 与接口地址仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
descriptionEn: Gangtise MCP aggregates institutional-grade insights, meeting notes, event calendars, and other alternative data, while providing AI-agent-ready, pre-generated research content alongside structured global market, financial, valuation, and industry data. Keys and Base URL are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy.
